title: Patch: a gray Allure-style outline on a card with 1 Brittle left
thread:
**Issue #2270 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2270: Patch: a gray Allure-style outline on a card with 1 Brittle left
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

A card on the field whose Brittle count is **1** crumbles at its next Brittle tick (SPEC §2.2, §6.1, R385). Make that easy to see: while the view gives a card `brittle === 1` on the field, draw the **Allure mark's aura** around it (the corruption aura `cards/CardMarks.tsx` draws for the `allure` mark, R963, R1045000: the vignette, the edge and the drifting motes from `cards/marks.css`), recoloured **gray**.

This reuses the existing aura the way Duo already recolours Allure's aura in gold (`DUO_MARK_COLOR`, `cards/marks.ts`):

- Add a `gray` entry to `MARK_PALETTES` in `cards/marks.ts` (rim, core and glow in neutral grays that read on both the light and dark board, with a quiet particle preset), and a named constant for it, for example `BRITTLE_LAST_COLOR: MarkColor = "gray"`, documented like `ALLURE_MARK_COLOR`.
- Draw **only the aura, without the mark badge**: this is not a mark and nothing is "Marked", so no `card-mark-badge` and none of the mark's words. A prop on `CardMarks` (or a small shared aura component pulled out of it) is fine; reuse the existing CSS rather than copying it.
- **Where:** cards on the field with a Brittle count in the view: units (`UnitView.brittle`) and any other permanent whose `CardView.brittle` is set (a face-up backrow or Animated card), on both sides of the board. Not in the hand, the deck or anywhere else: Brittle ticks on the field only (R385, R638).
- **Precedence:** a card that also carries a real mark (Allure, Duo, steal…) keeps its mark's aura and badge; the gray aura is drawn only when the card has no mark aura of its own.
- Brittle's own cracks and count shard (`cards/keywordVisuals.ts`, `brittleStage`, keywords.css) are unchanged and sit under the aura as now.
- Motion follows the marks' rules: it moves only under full motion and is held still, still drawn, under the reduced-motion media query and `<html data-reduce-motion="true">` (marks.css already does this). No pointer events (the aura already takes none).
- Read only what the view gives (CLAUDE.md rule 7): `brittle === 1`, not the keyword's printed number. Compare against a named constant (for example `BRITTLE_LAST_COUNT = 1` beside `BRITTLE_CRACK_STAGES` in `keywordVisuals.ts`), not a bare `1` (rule 9).

## Acceptance

- A vitest test: a field unit with `brittle: 1` renders the aura with `data-mark-color="gray"` and no `card-mark-badge`; with `brittle: 2` or no Brittle it renders none; a unit with `brittle: 1` that also carries an `allure` mark renders the pink Allure aura and its badge, not the gray one.
- A vitest test that a hand card whose view has `brittle: 1` gets no gray aura.
- The existing marks and keyword-visual tests (`cards/keywordVisuals.test.tsx`, the CardMarks tests) still pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing: it does not need the hand hint system.
```
